You can run BF on python or R. For R users you need to have installed python and the R [**reticulate**](https://rstudio.github.io/reticulate/).


::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}
## Python
``` python
#| code-fold: false
pip install BayesForge # For CPU support
pip install BayesForge[gpu] # For GPU support 
```

## R
``` R
#| code-fold: false
package.install(BayesForge)
```
:::

::: callout-note
* GPU support is only available for linux and WSL2 systems.
:::
